entries.name: Home Invasion
entries.comment: JUDGEMENT CALL: Spotify only has the combined track "Home Invasion / Regret #9"; setlist.fm lists the two halves separately. No candidate, so Not found (MATCH-9, no guesses). Accepted limitation, not a rule bug.

entries.name: Regret #9
entries.comment: JUDGEMENT CALL: Same as #1. "Regret #9 - Alternate Take" exists but "Alternate Take" is not a marker, which is right: an alternate take should not stand in for the song.

entries.name: Lazarus
entries.comment: "Lazarus (2015 Recording)" by Steven Wilson on "Transience". JUDGEMENT CALL: Cover of Porcupine Tree (Steven Wilson's own band). The band pass finds Steven Wilson's studio re-recording "Lazarus (2015 Recording)" on "Transience" and prefers it to his live version (MATCH-6), so it is Found and Porcupine Tree is never searched for. This relies on the step 09 marker fix ("‹year› Recording" added next to "‹year› Version"); before it, the live version was chosen. The setlist note says it was played acoustic, which is ignored (ENT-6).
